plugin.note: Use Taverley Dungeon or Chasm of Fire for regular Black demons; both are cannonable and have safespots. Black demons are weak to demonbane weapons and water spells. Demonic gorillas are a slower profitable alternative only for non-Krystilia and non-Konar assignments.

requirements: Demonbane weapons or water spells recommended
Monkey Madness II for Demonic gorillas
A Kingdom Divided plus Yama contract for Chasm of Fire contract drops
mechanics: Black demons can be safespotted with Ranged or Magic.
Melee setups can use Protect from Melee.
Black demons are weak to demonbane weapons.
Black demons are also weak to water spells.
Regular black demons have high stats and a poor drop table, so regular tasks are often skipped.
Catacombs black demons have unusually higher Defence and the four-spawn layout is awkward to use.
Demonic gorillas require two combat styles and are slower but profitable.
Wilderness Black demon locations are under 30 Wilderness, with Edgeville easier to escape and Wilderness Slayer Cave multicombat.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use cannonable safespot locations for regular Black demons, or swap to Demonic gorillas for eligible profit-focused assignments.
recommendedFor: choosing between speed, safety, Wilderness risk, and Demonic gorillas
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged or Magic gear for safespotting
prayers: Protect from Melee for melee tanking
steps: Choose Taverley Dungeon or Chasm of Fire for the strongest regular-task options.
Use a cannon where allowed to speed up regular Black demon kills.
Use demonbane melee, Ranged, or Magic safespots depending on gear and risk preference.
Avoid Catacombs as a default because the Black demon variants there have unusually higher Defence and awkward spawn use.
Consider Demonic gorillas only when the assignment is not from Krystilia or Konar and profit is preferred over speed.
notes: Regular black demons have a near non-existent drop table for the time spent killing them.
Lower-level players may need safespotting, which significantly lowers kill rates.

methods.label: Taverley Dungeon cannon
methods.summary: Use Taverley Dungeon for dense regular Black demon spawns with cannon support.
recommendedFor: players with Dusty Key or 70 Agility access
steps: Enter Taverley Dungeon with Dusty Key or 70 Agility access.
Place a cannon in the Black demon area.
Use the south-west stalagmite safespot or north-east crevice safespot.
Use demonbane melee with Protect from Melee if not safespotting.
notes: The task page highlights Taverley Dungeon as one of the two best regular Black demon spots.

methods.label: Chasm of Fire
methods.summary: Use Chasm of Fire for more safespots and optional Yama contract value.
recommendedFor: players with A Kingdom Divided and Yama contract access
requiredOrKeyItems: A Kingdom Divided for Yama contracts
steps: Use the bottom level of Chasm of Fire for 17 Black demon spawns.
Safespot by far-north stalagmites or near the Voice of Yama.
Use a cannon to speed up kills.
If signed with Yama, decide whether catering to contract preferences is worth reduced AFK time.
notes: The page says Chasm of Fire has more safespots than Taverley Dungeon.
Yama contract drop rate is increased when killing according to preference, but doing so can prolong tasks.

methods.label: Catacombs of Kourend
methods.summary: Use Catacombs only when Ancient shards or Dark totem pieces matter more than task efficiency.
steps: Use Catacombs if Ancient shard and Dark totem piece chances are desired.
Safespot or use Protect from Melee.
Expect worse efficiency due to higher Defence and awkward spawn utilisation.
notes: The page says it is generally not worth killing Black demons in the Catacombs.

methods.label: Wilderness locations
methods.summary: Use Edgeville Dungeon or Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting Wilderness risk.
steps: Use Edgeville Dungeon when easier escape is preferred.
Use Wilderness Slayer Cave for multicombat and its different drop table.
Bring low-risk gear and leave if player-killing risk increases.
Avoid hopping inside Wilderness Slayer Cave when aggression makes it risky.
notes: Both Wilderness Black demon locations are under 30 Wilderness.
Wilderness Slayer Cave has one entrance and is multicombat.

methods.label: Demonic gorilla alternative
methods.summary: Kill Demonic gorillas instead of Black demons for eligible assignments when profit is preferred.
steps: Only choose Demonic gorillas if the assignment came from a Slayer master other than Krystilia or Konar.
Bring two combat styles for the gorilla mechanics.
Use demonbane melee and a ranged switch.
Expect slower task completion but better profit from Zenyte shard chance.
notes: Demonic gorillas are quite profitable but slower than regular Black demons.

methods.label: Boss and miniquest variants
methods.summary: Skotizo, Balfrug Kreeyath, Porazdir, Kolodion, and the Grand Tree black demon are included as source context where the wiki lists them.
steps: Use Skotizo only as a separate dark totem boss trip.
Treat Balfrug Kreeyath as K'ril Tsutsaroth bodyguard context.
Treat Porazdir as Mage Arena II or imbued zamorak cape reobtain context.
Treat Kolodion as a one-time Mage Arena miniquest kill.
Nightmare Zone Grand Tree black demon kills count for task progress after The Grand Tree.
notes: Kolodion can only be killed once during the Mage Arena miniquest.
The Grand Tree black demon can be killed again in Nightmare Zone and counts for Black demon tasks.

styleOptions.label: Melee demonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use demonbane melee with Protect from Melee or cannon support.

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged safespots for lower-level accounts or lower-risk regular kills.

styleOptions.label: Magic water
styleOptions.summary: Use water spells or powered staves where Magic safespotting is preferred.
